data.body: Shard C completed its read-only survey of developer comments and embedded prose. It returned eleven candidate remediations. Confirmed P0 findings are the narrow scope and permissive citation exception in scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py, plus stale Jira backend and prompt count documentation. Confirmed P1 groups cover source comments and docstrings, executable prompts and schemas, diagnostics, public library docstrings, infrastructure comments, and diction. P2 groups cover test prose, experiment documentation, and redundant separators. The shard assigned client-facing presentation strings to shard B. It excluded generated evidence, external captures, wording fixtures, code syntax, technical identifiers, and necessary safety rationale from mechanical rewriting. The worktree remained clean.
